title_ru: JANUS Deep Analysis 5D: рекурсивный Transception + Reverse поверх HRain/iNaiHR
title_en: JANUS Deep Analysis 5D: Recursive Transception + Reverse over HRain/iNaiHR

MISSED_ON_FORWARD_PASS.finding: Линейный JSON заставляет новую мысль появляться после завершения основного текста, даже если логически она родилась внутри промежуточного узла.
MISSED_ON_FORWARD_PASS.repair: Treat the JSON as a recursive graph: every analytic node may spawn an inline local branch and return a LOCAL_DELTA to its parent.

MISSED_ON_FORWARD_PASS.finding: FORWARD/REVERSE сохраняет причинное зеркало, но теряет иерархию абстракции, ассоциативные боковые ветви и независимую ось provenance/authority.
MISSED_ON_FORWARD_PASS.repair: Use five independent analytic dimensions instead of one line traversed in two directions.

MISSED_ON_FORWARD_PASS.finding: Старый формат позволял заметить локальную альтернативу только в итоговом MIRROR_DELTA; к этому времени последующие узлы уже могли быть построены на чрезмерно сильной предпосылке.
MISSED_ON_FORWARD_PASS.repair: Open a micro-pass at the first node that becomes ambiguous; downstream reasoning must consume the repaired local node, not the unrepaired parent assumption.

core_rule: DEEP_ANALYSIS_IS_A_GRAPH_TRAVERSAL_NOT_A_LINEAR_APPEND_LOG. REVERSE DEFINES NECESSITY; TRANCEPTION EXPANDS LOCALLY; HRAIN PRESERVES STRUCTURE; INAIHR GENERATES ASSOCIATIVE CANDIDATES; DEMIHEAD PRESERVES DISAGREEMENT; PROVENANCE DECIDES PROMOTION.

D1_CAUSAL_TEMPORAL.question_forward: What follows if this node is true?
D1_CAUSAL_TEMPORAL.question_back: What had to be true immediately before this node?
D1_CAUSAL_TEMPORAL.source: JANUS forward/reverse mirror plus HRain inverse semantic dependency traversal.

D2_HOMOLOG_MIRROR.question_left: Which function-matched homolog shares role but not provenance?
D2_HOMOLOG_MIRROR.question_right: Which provenance/site/context-matched homolog shares context but not assumed identity?
D2_HOMOLOG_MIRROR.source: Existing JANUS reverse-only Tranception operator and matched controls.

D3_ABSTRACTION_HIERARCHY.question_ascend: What more abstract invariant, role, class, office, function or operator contains this node?
D3_ABSTRACTION_HIERARCHY.question_dive: Which concrete persons, objects, texts, dates, places or measurements instantiate that abstraction?
D3_ABSTRACTION_HIERARCHY.hrain_binding: Use HRain-style structural context and DIVE/ASCEND navigation as a software/research metaphor, not a neuroscience claim.

D4_ASSOCIATIVE_SEMANTIC.question_expand: What semantically adjacent candidate branch is suggested by this node, even if it is not yet evidence?
D4_ASSOCIATIVE_SEMANTIC.question_contract: Which associations survive relevance, matched-control and source-bound tests and deserve reintegration?
D4_ASSOCIATIVE_SEMANTIC.inaihr_binding: iNaiHR contributes ASSOCIATIVE_CONTEXT candidate generation; association is never automatically promoted to evidence.

D5_PROVENANCE_AUTHORITY.question_claim_to_source: What source, provenance, object record, genealogy, measurement or receipt would be required to support this claim?
D5_PROVENANCE_AUTHORITY.question_source_to_claim: What is the strongest claim this source actually permits without semantic strengthening?
D5_PROVENANCE_AUTHORITY.rule: MODEL_OUTPUT != EVIDENCE; ASSOCIATION != EVIDENCE; BOTH_HEMISPHERES_AGREE != TRUTH.

micro_pass_schema.anchor_node: the exact parent node where the branch was born
micro_pass_schema.why_opened_here: reason this cannot safely be postponed to the end
micro_pass_schema.LOCAL_MISSED: what the parent traversal had not represented
micro_pass_schema.RETURN_TO_PARENT_AS: RETAIN | SPLIT | WEAKEN | PROMOTE | REPLACE | KEEP_PARALLEL

node_local_recursive_expansion.important: A local branch is inserted conceptually at its anchor node even though JSON serialization remains textual. The logical graph order has priority over physical file order.

DEMIHEAD.promotion_rule: Agreement may prioritize a test but cannot create truth authority.

tranception_reverse_binding.legacy_local_sequence: BACK -> FORWARD -> LEFT -> RIGHT -> FORWARD -> BACK
tranception_reverse_binding.v2_extension: The legacy six-direction operator remains valid inside D1+D2, but Deep Analysis may additionally ASCEND/DIVE, EXPAND/CONTRACT and CLAIM_TO_SOURCE/SOURCE_TO_CLAIM at any encountered node.
tranception_reverse_binding.prebirth_principle: Do not build a large downstream branch and compress it afterward if a decisive invariant, identity split or matched control can be discovered at the parent node first.
tranception_reverse_binding.locality_rule: REVERSE DEFINES THE ROAD; TRANCEPTION EXPANDS THE LOCAL GAP; 5D RECURSION DECIDES WHERE THE GAP ITSELF SHOULD BE REDEFINED.

deep_analysis_execution.phase_0: Freeze question, claim ceiling and terminal state.
deep_analysis_execution.phase_1: Run a minimal forward structural pass without repairing it retroactively.
deep_analysis_execution.phase_2: Run reverse necessity traversal from terminal to source.
deep_analysis_execution.phase_3: Whenever a gap appears, open an inline 5D micro-pass at that exact node.
deep_analysis_execution.phase_4: Use D2 matched homologs and controls to test uniqueness.
deep_analysis_execution.phase_5: Use D3 to move between person/object details and role/function abstractions.
deep_analysis_execution.phase_6: Use D4 for associative candidate generation, then contract aggressively.
deep_analysis_execution.phase_7: Use D5 to assign every surviving edge a source/authority ceiling.
deep_analysis_execution.phase_8: Return every LOCAL_DELTA to its parent and replay only the affected downstream segment.
deep_analysis_execution.phase_9: Write global MISSED_ON_FORWARD_PASS first, followed by the graph of local discoveries, then the final surviving road and next gates.

canonical_seal: JANUS DOES NOT WAIT UNTIL THE END TO NOTICE A MISSING DIMENSION. OPEN THE BRANCH WHERE THE THOUGHT IS BORN, MIRROR IT, ABSTRACT IT, SOURCE IT, THEN RETURN IT TO THE GRAPH.
